models_evaluated: image-only ultrasound AI delivery-date prediction system

links.outcome: Delivery-date prediction error (MAE) in external validation at four Chilean public hospitals
links.effect: MAE 6.9 days (95% CI 6.7-7.0) across 3,788 studies; 6.4 days in pregnancies lacking reliable first-trimester dating vs 13.2 days for the due date.
links.quote: Across 3,788 singleton studies from 2,550 pregnancies at four Chilean public hospitals, the AI predicted the delivery date with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 6.9 days (95% confidence interval [CI] 6.7–7.0).

unlisted_practices: Providing calibrated prediction intervals for delivery-date estimates rather than a single date

screen.reason: Multicenter external validation of an image-only ultrasound AI model to predict delivery date in Chilean public hospitals, addressing equity gaps in late-presenting pregnancies.
